caption: The video captures a low-angle view of a shallow forest stream tumbling over dark, wet rocks. Lush green foliage fills the upper and left frame, while a thick bare branch arches across the top from the right and a dark mossy wall bounds the right side. In the background, the channel opens into a bright, fog-filled gap where diffuse light glows through the mist. Throughout the scene, white frothy rapids in the middle of the stream continuously churn, their foam patches changing shape and brightening and dimming as water moves toward the foreground. A pale streak of aerated water in the lower-left foreground shifts and reforms steadily, consistent with ongoing downstream flow. The central turbulent texture never settles, indicating continuous motion. The arching branch, lining rocks, surrounding leaves, and right-side wall hold the same positions, so the camera remains essentially fixed. The background mist and glow stay largely steady, with only subtle density variation as the water keeps flowing.
